summary.text: Andrew Bolin is the Libertarian candidate for the Missouri House of Representatives, District 83, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where Democratic incumbent Raymond Reed is also on the ballot.

paragraphs.text: Andrew Bolin advanced from the August 4, 2026 Libertarian Party primary for District 83.
Ballotpedia lists him as a candidate in the District 83 general election in 2018, 2020, 2022 and 2024, when Gina Mitten, Jo Doll, Sarah Unsicker and Raymond Reed, respectively, won the seat.
